success_12_months.economic: The virtual portfolio delivers a geometric mean net return of at least 0.5% across every preregistered exchange session in the full 12-month horizon, after simulated execution costs; no-trade sessions count as zero and this is not a mandatory daily quota.
success_12_months.capital: No real trading capital is exposed during the 12-month research horizon; Capex and Opex are real product investments tracked separately.
success_12_months.product_costs: Real forward data, infrastructure and approved Capex are deducted in the separate project-economics view, not from the virtual trading NAV.
success_12_months.risk: Peak-to-trough drawdown never exceeds 8% of the prior consolidated qualified-mark peak.
success_12_months.evidence: Any capital use obeys the frozen promotion gates; results remain fully attributable and reproducible.
success_12_months.operational: No unresolved material data, execution, ledger or audit-integrity failure invalidates the result.
success_12_months.negative_research_result: A correctly powered not-validated verdict is a valid research outcome but does not satisfy the economic trading-success target.
